name: Hoffman-Boston Elementary School
notes: Already funded; which stage it is in today is our reading of the CIP, not confirmed.

needs.title: Hoffman-Boston Elementary HVAC and roof replacement
needs.summary: HVAC modernization and roof replacement with ceilings, lighting, and interior finishes in affected areas. School Board-approved project budget $45.65M; completion anticipated Fall 2028.
needs.why_track: Funded through earlier bonds and the adopted CIP. The CIP gives a budget and a completion date but does not say whether design or construction is under way today.

milestones.label: Adopted CIP carries the School Board-approved $45.65M project budget
